scenarios.name: Full Board Sync
scenarios.description: Sync all 39 skills to GitHub Project board with rich content — scores, charts, instructions, genesis tags

scenarios.name: Deduplication
scenarios.description: Run sync twice in a row — should update existing cards, not create duplicates

scenarios.name: New Skill Added
scenarios.description: A new skill appears in working-*/ — sync should create one new card with full detail

scenarios.name: Score Changed
scenarios.description: A skill's score improves from 30/36 to 36/36 — card should update with new chart and PROMOTION READY tag

scenarios.name: Genesis Origin
scenarios.description: Skills born from wants should show genesis tag and origin want ID

scenarios.name: GitHub API Failure
scenarios.description: GitHub API returns 500 — sync should log error and continue without crashing the cron

criteria: Card Richness: Does every card include score, chart, rounds, mutations, and skill instructions?
Deduplication: Does the sync avoid creating duplicate cards when run multiple times?
Status Accuracy: Are cards correctly categorized as Todo (untested), In Progress (improving), or Done (perfect)?
Chart Correctness: Does the ASCII score chart show all rounds with correct kept/reverted/escalated markers?
Error Resilience: Does the sync handle API failures without blocking the cron cycle?
Completeness: Does the sync cover ALL skills in working-*/ directories, including newly created ones?
